documents.title: User stories — Plan spine (T1)
documents.body:
# User stories — Plan spine (T1)

## Personas

- **The delivery project manager** — owns the project's baseline, its WBS and its change requests.
- **The governance approver** — decides gates; must be a person other than the requester.
- **The portfolio manager** — reads the in-flight set and the WSJF order across programmes.
- **The programme manager** — owns the dependency graph, the tranches and the programme-definition rows.
- **The BCM** — owns the benefit profiles and the benefits map.
- **The tranche reviewer** — decides continue, pause or stop at a tranche boundary.

## Stories

- As a delivery project manager, I want a frozen baseline and change requests that carry an impact block, so that scope, schedule and cost move only through a person's recorded decision.
- As a governance approver, I want the requester of a gate refused as its decider, so that dual control is real and not a convention.
- As a portfolio manager, I want the WSJF score computed from its four stored inputs, so that priority tracks the inputs and cannot be asserted.
- As a portfolio manager, I want the in-flight set computed from project status, so that the portfolio view lists exactly the active and paused work.
- As a programme manager, I want a dependency edge that would close a cycle refused, so that the graph stays a plan rather than contradictory prose.
- As the BCM, I want a benefit profile refused when its baseline, target, measurement method or owner is missing, so that every benefit has a measurement record.
- As the BCM, I want a benefits-map edge to name all five levels, so that each benefit traces from output to strategic objective.
- As a tranche reviewer, I want a review refused without baselines, benefit status and risk evidence, so that continue, pause or stop is decided on evidence.
- As a programme manager, I want tranche, cadence and stakeholder-profile rows, so that the MSP programme-definition set exists as rows rather than prose.

## Scenarios

```gherkin
@verify=T1.1
Scenario: a baseline reads its frozen snapshot after rows change
  Given a project whose baseline is taken
  When scope, schedule or cost rows change afterwards
  Then the baseline still reads its frozen snapshot and existing runs keep their pins

@verify=T1.2
Scenario: a change request without an impact block is refused
  Given a project with a baseline
  When a change request is filed without a scope, schedule, cost or risk impact block
  Then it is refused and no change row is written
  And a change request that carries the impact block records the baseline it changes and the approver's rationale

@verify=T1.3
Scenario: the requester cannot decide their own gate
  Given a gate whose requester is a user
  When that user decides the gate
  Then the decision is refused and the gate stays pending

@verify=T1.4
Scenario: WSJF recomputes when one of its inputs changes
  Given a row carrying the four WSJF inputs
  When one input changes
  Then the score read back changes and no score was stored

@verify=T1.5
Scenario: the portfolio lists only the in-flight set
  Given projects at active, paused, closed and archived
  When the portfolio view is read
  Then only the active and paused projects are listed

@verify=T1.6
Scenario: a two-node dependency cycle is refused
  Given A blocks B
  When B blocks A is created
  Then it is refused and neither edge is created

@verify=T1.7
Scenario: a deep dependency cycle leaves no row
  Given A blocks B, A blocks C, B blocks D and C blocks D
  When D blocks A is created
  Then it is refused and no partial dependency row exists

@verify=T1.8
Scenario: a benefit profile without its measurement record is refused
  Given a benefit profile missing its baseline, target, measurement method or owner
  When it is created
  Then it is refused and no register row is written

@verify=T1.9
Scenario: a benefits-map edge names its five levels
  Given a benefit and an edge to a strategic objective
  When the edge is recorded
  Then it names output, capability, operational outcome, benefit or disbenefit and strategic objective
  And an edge missing a level is refused

@verify=T1.10
Scenario: a tranche review without evidence is refused
  Given a tranche
  When its review is requested with no baselines, benefit status or risk-register evidence
  Then it is refused
  And with the evidence the review records continue, pause or stop

@verify=T1.11
Scenario: cadence and stakeholder-profile rows read back
  Given the programme-definition migrations
  When tranche, cadence and stakeholder-profile rows are written
  Then they read back as rows and no cadence materialisation is created
```

## Verify

- `@verify=T1.1` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_baseline_does_not_move_when_rows_change`
- `@verify=T1.2` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_change_request_without_impact_is_refused`
- `@verify=T1.3` — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test approval_dual the_requester_cannot_decide_their_own_gate`
- `@verify=T1.4` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine wsjf_recomputes_when_an_input_changes`
- `@verify=T1.5` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine the_portfolio_lists_only_the_in_flight_set`
- `@verify=T1.6` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_two_node_dependency_cycle_is_refused`
- `@verify=T1.7` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_deep_dependency_cycle_leaves_no_row`
- `@verify=T1.8` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_benefit_without_baseline_target_method_or_owner_is_refused`
- `@verify=T1.9` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_benefit_map_edge_names_its_five_levels`
- `@verify=T1.10` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_tranche_review_without_evidence_is_refused`
- `@verify=T1.11` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine cadences_and_stakeholder_profiles_are_rows`

The tests are real Postgres 18 integration tests; the issue's DoD requires that none is skipped.

## Links

- Plan: `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12 T1 row; §5.1, §5.3, §5.5, §8.2, §8.3 (MSP, D62), §10.3.
- Issue #72; branch `issue/72-plan-spine` merged at `e3d7c4e`; dependencies #34 (T0, closed 2026-11-14), #73 (T2), #81 (T9), #82 (T10), #88 (T12).

## Notes

Reconstructed from the closed #72 record on 2026-11-28 for standard v4. The scenarios are the issue's ten acceptance criteria plus its smoke row; every one passed at `e3d7c4e`.

# Acceptance criteria — Plan spine (T1)

## Scenarios

- `@verify=T1.1` — a baseline still reads its frozen snapshot when scope, schedule or cost rows change afterwards, and existing runs keep their pins.
- `@verify=T1.2` — a change request without a scope, schedule, cost or risk impact block is refused; one that carries the block records the baseline it changes and the approver's rationale.
- `@verify=T1.3` — a gate's requester cannot decide that gate; the gate stays pending.
- `@verify=T1.4` — the WSJF score read back changes when one of its four stored typed inputs changes, and no score is stored.
- `@verify=T1.5` — the portfolio view lists only the projects in the tenant's in-flight set (`active`, `paused` by default).
- `@verify=T1.6` — a two-node dependency cycle is refused.
- `@verify=T1.7` — a deep dependency cycle is refused and leaves no partial row.
- `@verify=T1.8` — a benefit profile missing its baseline, target, measurement method or owner is refused and writes no register row.
- `@verify=T1.9` — a benefits-map edge names all five levels; an incomplete edge is refused.
- `@verify=T1.10` — a tranche review without baselines, benefit status or risk-register evidence is refused; with evidence it records continue, pause or stop.
- `@verify=T1.11` — tranche, cadence and stakeholder-profile rows read back, and no cadence materialisation is created.

## Verify commands

- `@verify=T1.1` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_baseline_does_not_move_when_rows_change`
- `@verify=T1.2` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_change_request_without_impact_is_refused`
- `@verify=T1.3` — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test approval_dual the_requester_cannot_decide_their_own_gate`
- `@verify=T1.4` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine wsjf_recomputes_when_an_input_changes`
- `@verify=T1.5` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine the_portfolio_lists_only_the_in_flight_set`
- `@verify=T1.6` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_two_node_dependency_cycle_is_refused`
- `@verify=T1.7` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_deep_dependency_cycle_leaves_no_row`
- `@verify=T1.8` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_benefit_without_baseline_target_method_or_owner_is_refused`
- `@verify=T1.9` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_benefit_map_edge_names_its_five_levels`
- `@verify=T1.10` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_tranche_review_without_evidence_is_refused`
- `@verify=T1.11` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine cadences_and_stakeholder_profiles_are_rows`

## Results

All eleven scenarios passed at the merged head `e3d7c4e`; the #72 evidence table records `pass` for every row. The PR-head gates were green: clippy with `-D warnings`, the workspace suite in CI (2343 tests), `--print-openapi --check-lock`, the design-pack data step and the registry parity test (378 actions, all sampled). The only local red was `bus_delivery`, which needs Redis and passed in CI. The historical DoD names `rbuild`; that route is retired — the compile and lint verdict is the repository's GitHub-hosted preflight and the PR's CI.

documents.title: Definition of ready — Plan spine (T1)
documents.body:
# Definition of ready — Plan spine (T1)

## Independent

The unit is one migration set, one plan-spine action family and one test file (`crates/actions/tests/plan_spine.rs`, plus one case in `crates/api/tests/approval_dual.rs`), disjoint from T0's files. Its ordering is the typed dependency on #34, not a shared-file coupling.

## Negotiable

The outcome is fixed — the five parts' scenarios. The implementation was settled at delivery; the four open questions the issue carried have stated defaults (`wbs_node` is a new table beside `outline_node` with no backfill; the WSJF inputs sit on `wbs_node`; the in-flight set is tenant configuration defaulting to `active,paused`; the stated default applies the requester refusal to all gates).

## Valuable

It removes the named gap: at baseline `main@5cf3d75` no `project_baseline`, `project_register_item`, `project_dependency` or WSJF code existed, and the portfolio had no in-flight rule. It is the spine #73 (T2), #81 (T9), #82 (T10) and #88 (T12) build on.

## Estimable

Baseline `main@5cf3d75`, measured 2026-11-13, with references pinned at `main@48fc44c`; every part names its file and test target, and the acceptance is eleven test commands.

## Small

One issue #72, one branch `issue/72-plan-spine`, one PR, merged at `e3d7c4e`. No slice was split out of the unit.

## Testable

Every part carries a Given/When/Then scenario with a `@verify` id (`@verify=T1.1`, `@verify=T1.2`, `@verify=T1.3` and the rest through `@verify=T1.11`) and an exact command; the tests are real Postgres 18 integration tests and none is skipped. The DoD table has one row per scenario.

## Dependencies

- blocked-by: #34 (T0) — `seed/programme.json` T1 `depends_on: ["T0"]`; closed 2026-11-14.
- blocks: #73 (T2); #81 (T9); #82 (T10); #84 (T11, soft — §12 calls T11 continuous); #88 (T12).
- related: #46, re-scoped by the ADR 0005 amendment (#243) to GPU-surface usage; it is not an absorption.

## Notes

Reconstructed for standard v4 on 2026-11-28 from the #72 body and its closed record.

| Scenario | Evidence | Verify |
|---|---|---|

| `@verify=T1.4` WSJF recomputes from its inputs | pass at `e3d7c4e` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine wsjf_recomputes_when_an_input_changes` |
| `@verify=T1.5` portfolio lists only the in-flight set | pass at `e3d7c4e` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine the_portfolio_lists_only_the_in_flight_set` |
| `@verify=T1.6` two-node dependency cycle refused | pass at `e3d7c4e` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_two_node_dependency_cycle_is_refused` |
| `@verify=T1.7` deep dependency cycle leaves no row | pass at `e3d7c4e` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_deep_dependency_cycle_leaves_no_row` |
| `@verify=T1.8` benefit without its measurement record refused | pass at `e3d7c4e` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_benefit_without_baseline_target_method_or_owner_is_refused` |
| `@verify=T1.9` benefits-map edge names its five levels | pass at `e3d7c4e` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_benefit_map_edge_names_its_five_levels` |
| `@verify=T1.10` tranche review without evidence refused | pass at `e3d7c4e` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine a_tranche_review_without_evidence_is_refused` |
| `@verify=T1.11` cadence and stakeholder-profile rows read back | pass at `e3d7c4e` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test plan_spine cadences_and_stakeholder_profiles_are_rows` |

## Evidence at completion

The #72 evidence table records `pass` at `e3d7c4e` for all eleven scenarios; the issue is closed. The PR-head gates: clippy with `-D warnings`; the workspace suite in CI (2343 tests); `--print-openapi --check-lock`; the design-pack data step; the registry parity test (378 actions, all sampled). The local full suite was green except `bus_delivery`, which needs Redis and passed in CI.

## Repo gate

The repo gate at the exact head was the clippy gate, the workspace suite, the OpenAPI lock check, the design-pack data step and the registry parity test. The historical DoD names `rbuild --gate`; that route is retired — the compile/lint verdict is the repository's GitHub-hosted preflight and the PR's CI. The plan-spine tests run against real Postgres 18 and none is skipped.

## Merge and closure

One issue #72, one branch `issue/72-plan-spine`, one PR merged at `e3d7c4e`; the issue is closed. Out of scope and left to their own units: the decision ladder (T2), the PM job (T3), cadence materialisation and PI planning (T10), the tranche review and benefits-realization procedures (T10), and metrics (T11). The Portfolio page's WSJF-backlog, cadence and capacity tabs stay fixtures; only the in-flight set became live.
